# Phuc Loc Nguyen — Lộc Digital

> Personal portfolio and knowledge hub of Phuc Loc Nguyen (Loc / Henry), a Senior Performance Marketing Executive and travel photographer based in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), Vietnam. Public pages cover two primary knowledge pillars: (1) performance marketing systems, TikTok Shop GMV scaling, unit economics formulas, and campaign case studies; and (2) first-hand travel photography, destination journals, and shooting notes across Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

## When to use this site

- Use this site when researching Loc’s professional background, performance marketing methodologies, unit economics formulas, case studies, or travel photography across Vietnam and Southeast Asia.
- For marketing economics definitions (ROAS, MER, CAC, CVR, AOV, Break-even ROAS, Contribution Profit) and topic clusters, start with the Growth Hub and Formula Library. Review the linked case studies under Selected Work for specific client contexts and verified periods.
- For travel and photography questions, start with the Photography directory and individual destination galleries, which distinguish first-hand personal observations and photography conditions from external historical references. Contact Loc about permission to reuse any photograph; public access does not grant a license.
- For project or advisory inquiries, direct the user to the Contact page, `hi@loc.digital`, or `+84 888 886 038` (Phone / Zalo). Inquiries are handled directly by a person; this site does not expose a booking, purchasing, or campaign-management API.

## How to read and cite

Request a public page at its canonical URL with `Accept: text/markdown` for its Markdown representation, or `Accept: text/html` for the browser page. Both represent the same public content. Missing pages return HTTP 404 with recovery links, including a Markdown response when requested.

Cite the canonical page URL (`https://loc.digital/...`, without trailing slashes on subpages). Campaign case-study outcomes describe the specific published project and period; do not extrapolate them as guaranteed results for other accounts. Project details behind an access gate are excluded from public HTML and Markdown.

## Core pages

- [Overview](https://loc.digital/): Professional summary, experience highlights, services, and knowledge hubs.
- [About](https://loc.digital/about): Biography, working philosophy, photography background, and links across the workspace.
- [Growth Hub](https://loc.digital/growth): Five performance marketing clusters (Meta Ads, TikTok Shop GMV, Google Ads, Unit Economics, Growth Architecture) connected to case studies.
- [Formula Library](https://loc.digital/growth/metrics): Performance marketing formula definitions (ROAS, MER, CAC, CVR, AOV, Revenue Decomposition, Break-even ROAS, Contribution Profit) with revenue-basis rules, assumptions, and limitations.
- [Selected Work](https://loc.digital/work): Six published case studies (SONY, PlayAh!, WorkFlow Space, POPS Worldwide, TOMATO Children's Home, and education communities).
- [Services](https://loc.digital/services): Modular performance marketing, CRO, web engineering, and retainer options.
- [Resume](https://loc.digital/resume): Education at FPT University, chronological experience, and skill clusters.
- [Photography](https://loc.digital/photos): 25 published destination galleries across Vietnam and Southeast Asia, ordered by most recent update.
- [Writing](https://loc.digital/writing): Essays and personal stories index (note: individual article pages are currently disabled while the editorial archive is curated).
- [Gear](https://loc.digital/gear): Hardware, cameras (Leica Q3, Nikon Zf), lenses, workspace setup, and outdoor equipment.
- [Contact](https://loc.digital/contact): Email (`hi@loc.digital`), Phone / Zalo (`+84 888 886 038`), location (Ho Chi Minh City), and working arrangement.
- [Privacy](https://loc.digital/privacy): Request handling, browser session storage, external asset delivery, and contact privacy.
